tasks.prompt: Add a res.noStore() method to Express responses. It sets the Cache-Control header to 'no-store' and returns the response so it can be chained, e.g. res.noStore().send('ok'). Make sure the existing test suite still passes.

Add a req.bearerToken getter to Express requests. It returns the token from an 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header (the scheme is case-insensitive, surrounding whitespace is trimmed) and undefined when the header is missing or uses another scheme. Add tests for it.

Add res.cacheFor(seconds) to Express responses: it sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=<seconds>' and returns the response. It must throw a TypeError when seconds is not a non-negative integer. Run the tests before you finish.

Add res.problem(status, detail) to Express responses. It sends an RFC 9457 problem response: status code <status>, Content-Type application/problem+json, and body {"type":"about:blank","title":<the standard reason phrase for status>,"status":<status>,"detail":<detail>}. detail is optional and omitted from the body when not given.
Export the Express version: require('express').version should be the version string from package.json. Keep everything else working.
Change res.send(null) so that it sends the JSON text null with Content-Type application/json, the same way res.json(null) does. Make sure the tests pass.
